title: KP tutorial-card browser/embed hardening loop

sourceRefs.summary: Near-term priorities start with browser smoke coverage for iframe, static-step, and programming sample launch paths before GIF/video export.
Active thread names browser launch-path hardening as the current next action.
Closeout review identifies the broad verification gap this hardening loop addresses.

allowedWork: Only work on approved KP tutorial-card browser/embed hardening slices.
Keep iframe, static-step, programming, graph, and dashboard launch-path work tied to existing tutorial-card runtime artifacts.
Use static programming execution traces only; do not build an interpreter in this loop.
Record each slice in Theseus and commit after focused verification passes.
disallowedWork: Do not start GIF, MP4, or WebM encoder implementation before browser smoke paths are stable.
Do not start the full SemanticObject registry/capability loading loop in this contract.
Do not broaden into unrelated Theseus planner infrastructure beyond retiring stale queue state.
Do not pursue visual polish unless it blocks launch smoke reliability.
goal: Prove concrete tutorial-card iframe, static-step, programming, graph, and dashboard launch surfaces can render, seek, expose fallbacks/dependencies, and report readiness before moving into media export or broader capability registry work.
stopConditions: Stop when verification fails and needs user judgment.
Stop when the approved slice list is exhausted.
Stop if a slice would broaden beyond the approved KP tutorial-card browser/embed hardening loop.
Stop before implementing GIF/video encoders or a full programming interpreter.
